themes.label: Exams and grading
themes.selection: Check the current exam formats and assessment weights, and consider how the exam schedule fits with your other courses.
themes.study: Confirm the exam scope and format early. Practise under timed conditions and focus on understanding rather than memorising answers.

themes.label: Programming and debugging
themes.selection: If you have limited programming experience, allow time for writing and debugging code when planning your workload.
themes.study: Run and modify examples yourself, write small tests for your programs, and keep notes on debugging.

themes.label: Class participation
themes.selection: Check the current participation and attendance requirements. Experiences from previous semesters may not reflect this semester's rules.
themes.study: Confirm participation marks and attendance rules at the start, and add class activities and submission deadlines to your calendar.

themes.label: Reading, writing and presentations
themes.selection: If you are taking other courses with substantial reading or presentations, compare their deadlines before finalising your course combination.
themes.study: Note the arguments and evidence as you read. Outline essays and presentations first, then check clarity and citations.
